text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While shopping, I see a limited-time sale
for a
variety pack of donuts.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! The Super XXL Variety Pack...
Today,
you're mine!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoooah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...H-h-hey, there! Fancy seein' you here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's no way I'd eat some kiddy
food like
that. I don't even like sweets!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But uh, my friend asked me to buy them,
so I'm
only here 'cause I have to be...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-so anyway, you here for the variety
pack too?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-so anyway, you here for the variety
pack too?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Really? It's not even that mu—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uh, never mind! Forget I said anything!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I guess it is a little much for one person...
I'll tell
my friend they were sold out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: W-well, I've got stuff to do. Peace!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Fresh-baked donuts, full of fluffy
cream...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Until we meet again... in my dreams...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka rips her gaze from the donuts and
runs
off...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Right? And they're freshly baked, so the
cream is
extra fluffy and amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Or at least that's what my friend said!
Haha...
ha...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we get some to split?
They'll sell
out if we keep standin'
around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Donuts safely purchased, Vodka and I
explore
their flavors to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh... What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the way the cream melts on the tip
of your
tongue just the best?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm just testin' the taste! It's not like I'm
hooked
or anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says that, but Vodka smoothly scarfs
down
the entire Super XXL Variety
Pack...
